title: House by the sea — Kobuleti
description: A house by the sea in Kobuleti, first line — for $365,000. House 187 m², plot 308 m². Built to European standards with a high-quality renovation, without furniture or appliances. Gas, water and electricity are connected. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, a 26 m² glass balcony around the second floor, and a spacious terrace on the third floor. 1st floor: a spacious hall with a fireplace, kitchen-living room, bathroom. 2nd floor: 3 spacious bedrooms, bathroom, 26 m² glass balcony with sea view. 3rd floor: a spacious terrace with a panoramic sea view, space for a lounge area, option to install an outdoor pool, barbecue area. First line to the sea, modern architecture, quality construction, maximum natural light thanks to panoramic glazing. An excellent option for permanent living, holidays or investment. Price: $365,000.
